metadata.title: Da3m.ma — The public funding your business qualifies for
metadata.description: Check your eligibility for Morocco's business-funding programmes, and understand why you qualify — or why not.

home.title: Find the public funding your business actually qualifies for.
home.tagline: Da3m.ma checks your situation against Morocco's business-funding programmes and tells you why you're eligible — or why not.

common.nonAffiliation: Da3m.ma is an independent tool. It is not a government platform and is not affiliated with any agency.

wizard.title: Check your eligibility
wizard.intro: Five questions, two minutes, no sign-up.
wizard.skipHint: Leave it blank and we will only ask again if a programme depends on it.

errors.invalid: One of the answers is not valid. Go back a step.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Your answers are kept — try again.

legal_form.label: Where are you today?
legal_form.help: Pick the current legal form of your activity.

sector.label: What sector are you in?
sector.help: The main sector — the one that will earn most of the revenue.

region.label: Which region?
region.help: The region where the activity is or will be based.

founder_age_band.label: How old are you?
founder_age_band.help: Some programmes are reserved for young founders.

is_mre.label: Are you a Moroccan living abroad?
is_mre.help: Several schemes have a dedicated MRE strand.

company_age_months.label: How many months ago was your company registered?
company_age_months.help: Enter 0 if it was registered less than a month ago.

employees_band.label: How many people do you employ?

need_purposes.label: What will the funding be used for?
need_purposes.help: You can pick more than one.

is_rural.label: Is your project in a rural area?
is_rural.help: A rural commune under the administrative division.

is_innovative.label: Is your project innovative?
is_innovative.help: A new product, process or business model — not merely new to you.

innovation_stage.label: How far along is your innovation?

has_partner_support.label: Are you supported by a partner organisation?
has_partner_support.help: An incubator, accelerator or accredited support organisation.

partner_invested.label: Has that organisation invested in your company?
partner_invested.help: An equity stake, not just mentoring.

raised_external_funding.label: Have you already raised outside funding?
raised_external_funding.help: Business angels, venture capital or seed funds.

revenue_growing.label: Is your revenue growing?
revenue_growing.help: Over the last two financial years.

exports_to_africa.label: Do you export to sub-Saharan Africa?
exports_to_africa.help: Or are preparing to set up in those markets.

has_intelaka_loan.label: Do you hold a loan guaranteed under Intelaka?
has_intelaka_loan.help: An investment loan already granted under the programme.

legal_form.none: I have not set up my business yet
